headline: A DEFENSE AND A KICKER ARE WINNING THIS LEAGUE

sections.heading: EARLY RETURNS
sections.body: Thursday night is in the books, Sunday hasn't happened, and Keeneng is already doing a victory lap. Erling Haaland sits on 29.45, which sounds impressive until you read the box score: the Seahawks defense put up 14.25 and Jason Myers kicked in 7.0, meaning 72 percent of the league-leading score came from guys who don't touch the ball on purpose. Matthew Stafford and Davante Adams chipped in 4.1 apiece, a combined 8.2 from two starters who were supposed to be the reason you drafted them. Michelob Plus Ultra is on the wrong end of it at 11.30, all of it Christian McCaffrey, and KevinVang still has eight starters breathing. This is a lead the way a coin flip in mid-air is a lead.

sections.heading: THE ZERO CLUB
sections.body: Three teams put up a clean 0.00: Tub89's Hmoob Meka Hiluss, jayvang100, and imbackbeech's Two-Minute Cumback Kingz. Before anyone starts the group chat, this is not a lineup crime — none of them rostered a single Thursday player, so they've simply been sitting in the parking lot while the rest of the league got a head start. Tub89 has Justin Herbert, CeeDee Lamb and Justin Jefferson all still to come and is technically losing 11.82 to nothing to a man whose entire offense so far is Drake Maye. jayvang100 is down 12.00 to a lone Rhamondre Stevenson. imbackbeech trails 6.80 to a running back named Jadarian Price, which is the single most humbling sentence this recap will produce. The Cumback Kingz have a name to live up to and, to be fair, a full slate to do it with.

sections.heading: WAIVER WIRE FREE JAZZ
sections.body: ChunckyM filed eight of the league's twenty-seven transactions, six of them in the last 48 hours before kickoff, and the tape is something to behold. Monday night he cut Trevor Lawrence to sign kicker Cameron Dicker. One minute later he added the Raiders defense, dropped it for the Chiefs twenty-five minutes after that, then reversed the whole thing the next afternoon and went back to the Raiders. Tuesday evening he dropped Dicker for Darren Waller, and then Thursday, hours before the games, he signed Cameron Dicker again. Two round trips in three days, one of them to a kicker. Keeneng meanwhile just quietly claimed the Trevor Lawrence that ChunckyM had thrown out, dropping Jordan Love to do it, which is the waiver equivalent of taking a couch off the curb. And the infuriating part: Shadow Monarch is second in the league at 22.20, every single point from Jaxon Smith-Njigba, a player ChunckyM somehow never got around to churning.

sections.heading: MOVES THAT AGED IN HOURS
sections.body: KevinVang cut Calvin Ridley back on August 26 to make room for the Titans defense, then on September 10 dropped the Titans for the Bears. So the receiver is gone, the defense he traded him for is also gone, and Michelob Plus Ultra is sitting on 11.30 wondering where the depth went. YMVtheDAD ran a similar loop with less to show for it: signed Keenan Allen on the 25th, dropped Keenan Allen on the 30th for Kayshon Boutte, and somewhere in between released Cameron Dicker, who ChunckyM promptly adopted, dropped, and adopted again. Evz132 got the week's most artistic bad break instead. I am DOOM leads on Mike Evans' 13.9, but the Rams defense went out and posted negative 1.2, actively taxing the roster. Sitting on 12.70 while one of your own starters plays defense against you takes a special kind of luck. And spare a thought for muahuavang, whose Ulysseus has 3.70 from the Patriots defense (2.7) and Harrison Mevis (1.0) — the lowest total in the league that isn't a zero, assembled entirely out of a defense and a kicker. Travis Kelce, Nico Collins and Malik Nabers are all still to come, so it's salvageable, but right now it reads like a punt returner's stat line.

sections.heading: WHAT'S ACTUALLY AT STAKE
sections.body: The closest real fight is UnderDogStyle over DarkHado, 14.00 to 9.50, and it is genuinely nothing: cvang1990's entire score is Kyren Williams, Tonglue's is Blake Corum plus 4.1 of A.J. Brown, and between them Lamar Jackson and Jalen Hurts haven't taken a snap. The widest gap is Keeneng's 18.15 over KevinVang, which will survive exactly as long as De'Von Achane and Derrick Henry cooperate. Nobody has a win, nobody has a loss, and the eleven teams that have scored at all are packed inside twenty-six points with the overwhelming majority of the week unplayed. Enjoy the standings while they're still fiction. The real recap lands next Saturday, and it will have receipts.
